newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB fixes crown +2.70 pct vs mark/usd basket.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB fixes crown +2.70 pct vs mark/usd basket.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) fixed the crown at 26.519 to the dollar after Wednesday's fixing at 26.425, and at 17.903 to the mark from 17.811.
The above rates imply a deviation from the midpoint of the central bank's mark/dollar basket of +2.70 percent compared with a deviation of +3.15 on Wednesday.
During the minute at which the central bank calculated today's fixing, the crown traded on the interbank market at +2.69 percent over the basket.
The crown fixing is announced daily at about 1140 CET (0940 GMT) and is within plus/minus 7.5 percent of the mid-point of a mark/dollar basket midpoint calculated between 11:30:00 and 11:30:59 CET.
